claim: crash-time audit consistency, cross-replica erasure, metadata encryption and onward propagation need resolution for regulated use
evidence: docs/compliance/controls.toml rows CRA-AI-I-2e (partial), GDPR-5-2 (partial), GDPR-17-2-19 (integrator). Crash-time audit consistency, read in the code: AuditedTaskStore::append_event (audit/task_store.rs) appends to the log and then writes the `task.event` record, and `record_event` returns nothing, so a crash between the two leaves an event in the log with no audit record; nothing checks the chain against the log's positions (AuditLog::verify checks the chain only). EncryptedTaskStore leaves ids, states, timestamps, metadata and order in the clear.
action: not built; each is a format or protocol change. A coverage check of the audit chain against the event log is the cheapest first step
